name: Deep afro one-drop sub
desc: The spacious counterpart to the rolling bass: a deep round triangle sub in a one-drop pocket, holding the root of each chord in the I-vi-IV-V (E C#m A B) walk with a slow dark filter and a mask('<1 1 1 0>') that drops the fourth bar for structural breathing.

code.full: note('<[e1 ~ ~ e2 ~ ~ b1 ~] [c#1 ~ ~ c#2 ~ ~ g#1 ~] [a1 ~ ~ a2 ~ ~ e2 ~] [b1 ~ ~ b2 ~ ~ f#2 ~]>').add(note(${root})).s('triangle').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).attack(.01).decay(.35).sustain(.5).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).mask('<1 1 1 0>').room(.12).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note('<[e1 e2 ~ e1 e2 b1 e2 ~] [c#1 c#2 ~ c#1 c#2 g#1 c#2 ~] [a1 a2 ~ a1 a2 e2 a2 ~] [b1 b2 ~ b1 b2 f#2 b2 ~]>').add(note(${root})).s('triangle').ftype('24db').lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*1.6).slow(12)).lpq(3).attack(.01).decay(.22).sustain(.3).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
